danamccool.editedBy: Theme tab of the studio (palette roles + fonts; /studio/theme)
notes: Fonts are chosen per role in /studio/theme and stored in site_config 'theme:fonts' (lib/fonts.ts): --dm-font-body, --dm-font-heading, --dm-font-nav, --dm-font-caption, --dm-font-reading; a page can override body and heading in its Page settings.
The palette writes the app's OWN variables first (--violet, --ink, ...) then the Tailwind kit names (--color-*), as an unlayered :root style.
